invite.noneBody: Invite a family, teacher or staff member to get started.

portfolio.title: Your portfolio starts here.
portfolio.body: Save photos, worksheets, projects and learning activities throughout the year. Later, Homeschool OS will help organize them automatically.

documents.title: Keep important papers in one place.
documents.body: Upload letters, certificates, test results and anything else worth keeping. You'll be able to find them by child and by year.

calendar.title: Nothing scheduled yet.
calendar.body: Add lessons, activities, field trips and appointments so everyone knows what's happening.

learning.title: Plan what you're teaching.
learning.body: Build a simple plan by subject. You can start with a single week and grow it from there.

progress.title: Progress appears as you go.
progress.body: Once you've logged some work, you'll see how each subject is coming along. We won't show a score until there's enough to be meaningful.

messages.title: No messages yet.
messages.body: When you're connected with a teacher, tutor or program, your conversations will appear here.

records.title: Florida homeschool records
records.body: We'll help you organize important homeschool documents and dates. Nothing here is filed for you, and we'll never tell you that you're compliant.

reports.title: Reports are coming.
reports.body: When you have lessons, work and progress recorded, you'll be able to generate a clean summary for any date range.

orgStudents.title: No students yet.
orgStudents.body: Students join when a family enrolls, or you can add one directly.

orgFamilies.title: No families yet.
orgFamilies.body: Invite a family to connect their students to your program.

orgStaff.title: No staff yet.
orgStaff.body: Invite teachers and staff so they can take attendance, plan lessons and record progress.

orgClasses.title: No classes yet.
orgClasses.body: Create a class or pod, then add the students who attend it.
